svg.text: The inductor resists the rising current,
The inductor now acts like a plain wire and
takes the current: the lamp goes out.
The inductor keeps the current flowing
conventional current direction; thick arrow = lots of current, thin dashed = a little
A real inductor has a little resistance, so the lamp never goes completely dark. This setup also nearly short-circuits the battery.
It is a demonstration of how an inductor behaves, not a circuit to build as a design.
